intro.title: A Rooftop Built for Every Kind of Gathering
intro.body1: Coco Maya sits at {{street}} in the heart of Little Italy, San Diego, with an elevated rooftop patio and an open-air glass atrium bar that make it one of the neighborhood's most requested spots for daily brunch, nightly dinner, happy hour, and private celebrations alike.
intro.body2: Whether you're gathering friends for a weekday happy hour, booking a milestone dinner, or planning a private buyout for a bachelorette party or corporate event, the patio adapts to the occasion without losing the San Diego skyline view.
intro.imageAlt: Rooftop patio with striped umbrellas at Coco Maya in Little Italy, San Diego
